items.name: Carrot
items.fact: Carrots are orange and help make your eyes strong and healthy

items.name: Broccoli
items.fact: Broccoli looks like tiny trees and is packed with vitamins

items.name: Tomato
items.fact: Tomatoes are actually a fruit but we eat them like a vegetable

items.name: Potato
items.fact: Potatoes grow underground and can be made into many yummy dishes

items.name: Corn
items.fact: Each corn cob has hundreds of tiny yellow kernels on it

items.name: Spinach
items.fact: Spinach makes you strong and healthy just like Popeye the sailor

items.name: Pea
items.fact: Tiny green peas grow snugly inside a long green pod

items.name: Cucumber
items.fact: Cucumbers are cool and refreshing and mostly made of water

items.name: Pepper
items.fact: Peppers come in red, yellow, orange, and green colors

items.name: Pumpkin
items.fact: Pumpkins are big orange vegetables used to make jack-o-lanterns

items.name: Onion
items.fact: Onions make your eyes water when you cut them due to a special chemical

items.name: Garlic
items.fact: Garlic is used in cooking all over the world and is good for your health

items.name: Cauliflower
items.fact: Cauliflower looks like a white version of broccoli and is very nutritious

items.name: Cabbage
items.fact: Cabbages are round leafy vegetables that can be purple or green

items.name: Eggplant
items.fact: Eggplants are shiny purple vegetables also known as aubergine

items.name: Zucchini
items.fact: Zucchinis are green summer squashes that grow very quickly

items.name: Asparagus
items.fact: Asparagus grows as tall spears and is one of the first vegetables to grow in spring

items.name: Celery
items.fact: Celery makes a crunchy snack and is almost all water and fiber

items.name: Radish
items.fact: Radishes are small spicy root vegetables that can be red or white

items.name: Beetroot
items.fact: Beetroot turns your hands and tongue a bright red or purple color

items.name: Sweet Potato
items.fact: Sweet potatoes are orange inside and packed with vitamins and nutrients

items.name: Artichoke
items.fact: The artichoke is actually a flower bud that we eat before it blooms

items.name: Leek
items.fact: Leeks look like giant green onions and taste mild and sweet when cooked

items.name: Kale
items.fact: Kale is one of the most nutritious leafy green vegetables you can eat

items.name: Brussels Sprout
items.fact: Brussels sprouts look like tiny cabbages and grow along a long thick stalk

items.name: Turnip
items.fact: Turnips are round white root vegetables with a slightly peppery taste

items.name: Parsnip
items.fact: Parsnips look like white carrots and taste sweet and nutty when roasted

items.name: Fennel
items.fact: Fennel has a mild licorice flavor and every part of it can be eaten

items.name: Bok Choy
items.fact: Bok choy is a Chinese cabbage with crunchy white stems and tender green leaves

items.name: Kohlrabi
items.fact: Kohlrabi looks like a small alien spaceship and tastes like mild broccoli

items.name: Watercress
items.fact: Watercress grows in fresh water streams and is one of the oldest eaten leaf vegetables

items.name: Arugula
items.fact: Arugula has a peppery spicy taste and is popular in salads

items.name: Swiss Chard
items.fact: Swiss chard has dark green leaves with bright red, yellow, or white stems

items.name: Collard Greens
items.fact: Collard greens are a staple of Southern cooking and very rich in calcium

items.name: Mustard Greens
items.fact: Mustard greens taste spicy and peppery and are common in Asian cuisine

items.name: Okra
items.fact: Okra is a green pod vegetable that gets sticky when cooked, great for thickening soups

items.name: Bean Sprout
items.fact: Bean sprouts are tiny germinated beans crunchy and fresh in stir-fries

items.name: Snow Pea
items.fact: Snow peas are flat pods where you eat the whole pod crunchy and sweet

items.name: Green Bean
items.fact: Green beans are long pods picked young and eaten whole cooked or raw

items.name: Butternut Squash
items.fact: Butternut squash has a sweet nutty flavor and turns bright orange when ripe

items.name: Acorn Squash
items.fact: Acorn squash is shaped like an acorn and has sweet orange flesh

items.name: Delicata Squash
items.fact: Delicata squash has cream and green striped skin that is edible when cooked

items.name: Romanesco
items.fact: Romanesco is a striking bright green vegetable that forms a perfect natural fractal pattern

items.name: Sunchoke
items.fact: Sunchokes are also called Jerusalem artichokes and taste sweet and nutty

items.name: Taro
items.fact: Taro is a starchy root vegetable used in Hawaiian poi and Asian cooking

items.name: Jicama
items.fact: Jicama is a crunchy white root vegetable that tastes like a cross between apple and potato

items.name: Water Chestnut
items.fact: Water chestnuts are crunchy aquatic vegetables that stay crispy even when cooked

items.name: Lotus Root
items.fact: Lotus root has a beautiful lace pattern when sliced and is crunchy to eat

items.name: Daikon
items.fact: Daikon is a giant white Japanese radish with a mild flavor

items.name: Celeriac
items.fact: Celeriac is the root of the celery plant with a mild celery-like flavor

items.name: Samphire
items.fact: Samphire is a crunchy sea vegetable that naturally tastes salty

items.name: Dandelion Greens
items.fact: Dandelion greens are edible and packed with more nutrients than many garden vegetables

items.name: Nettles
items.fact: Stinging nettles sting when raw but lose their sting completely when cooked

items.name: Purslane
items.fact: Purslane is a common weed that is actually highly nutritious and edible

items.name: Sorrel
items.fact: Sorrel has a sour lemony taste because it contains oxalic acid

items.name: Pak Choi
items.fact: Pak choi is a tender Asian green great for quick stir-frying

items.name: Enoki Mushroom
items.fact: Enoki mushrooms are long thin white mushrooms with tiny caps

items.name: Shiitake
items.fact: Shiitake mushrooms have a rich savory flavor and boost the immune system

items.name: Portobello
items.fact: Portobello mushrooms are large enough to grill like a burger patty

items.name: Oyster Mushroom
items.fact: Oyster mushrooms grow in fan-shaped clusters and have a delicate seafood-like taste

items.name: Truffle
items.fact: Truffles are rare underground fungi worth more than gold by weight

items.name: Chive
items.fact: Chives are the smallest members of the onion family used as a fresh herb garnish

items.name: Shallot
items.fact: Shallots taste milder and sweeter than onions and are popular in French cooking

items.name: Spring Onion
items.fact: Spring onions are young onions harvested before the bulb fully forms

items.name: Rapini
items.fact: Rapini or broccoli rabe has a pleasantly bitter taste popular in Italian cuisine

items.name: Fiddlehead Fern
items.fact: Fiddlehead ferns are young coiled fern fronds harvested in spring

items.name: Bamboo Shoot
items.fact: Bamboo shoots are young bamboo sprouts eaten as a crunchy vegetable in Asia

items.name: Galangal
items.fact: Galangal looks like ginger but tastes sharper and more piney

items.name: Turmeric
items.fact: Turmeric is a bright yellow root that stains everything it touches and is very healthy

items.name: Lemongrass
items.fact: Lemongrass is a tropical grass that smells and tastes like fresh lemon

items.name: Bitter Melon
items.fact: Bitter melon is a bumpy green vegetable that tastes very bitter but is medicinal

items.name: Moringa
items.fact: Moringa leaves are called miracle leaves because they are packed with nutrients

items.name: Chayote
items.fact: Chayote is a pear-shaped green vegetable with a crunchy mild flavor

items.name: Plantain
items.fact: Plantains look like bananas but are starchy and eaten cooked not raw

items.name: Yam
items.fact: True yams can grow over a meter long and are an important food in West Africa

items.name: Cassava
items.fact: Cassava is a starchy root that is the main ingredient in tapioca

items.name: Breadfruit
items.fact: Breadfruit is a starchy tropical vegetable that can replace bread and potatoes

items.name: Nopales
items.fact: Nopales are the edible pads of the prickly pear cactus popular in Mexico

items.name: Calabash
items.fact: Calabash is a gourd used as both a vegetable and a natural container

items.name: Malanga
items.fact: Malanga is a tropical root vegetable with a nutty earthy flavor

items.name: Amaranth Leaves
items.fact: Amaranth leaves are edible greens from the same plant that produces amaranth grain

items.name: Kabocha
items.fact: Kabocha is a Japanese pumpkin with green skin and very sweet dense flesh

items.name: Yard Long Bean
items.fact: Yard long beans can actually grow up to 18 inches in length

items.name: Winged Bean
items.fact: The winged bean has four frilly wings along its pod and is entirely edible

items.name: Tiger Nut
items.fact: Tiger nuts are not nuts but tiny root tubers that are sweet and crunchy

items.name: Chinese Broccoli
items.fact: Chinese broccoli has thick stems and bitter flat leaves popular in Asian cooking

items.name: Sea Beans
items.fact: Sea beans grow near the ocean and taste naturally salty without adding salt

items.name: Ground Cherry
items.fact: Ground cherries are small yellow fruits inside papery husks with a sweet pineapple taste

items.name: Romanesco Broccoli
items.fact: Romanesco broccoli forms a natural fractal spiral pattern and is bright lime green

items.name: Purple Cauliflower
items.fact: Purple cauliflower gets its color from anthocyanins the same pigment as blueberries

items.name: Radicchio
items.fact: Radicchio is a red leafy vegetable with a pleasantly bitter taste used in Italian salads

items.name: Endive
items.fact: Endive is a crisp slightly bitter lettuce used in elegant salads and appetizers

items.name: Mizuna
items.fact: Mizuna is a Japanese mustard green with feathery leaves and a mild peppery taste

items.name: Tatsoi
items.fact: Tatsoi forms a beautiful flat rosette of dark spoon-shaped leaves

items.name: Perilla
items.fact: Perilla is a fragrant Asian herb leaf used in Japanese and Korean cooking

items.name: Agretti
items.fact: Agretti is an Italian coastal green tasting slightly salty and resembling chives

items.name: Scorzonera
items.fact: Scorzonera is a black-skinned root vegetable with a mild oyster-like flavor

items.name: Salsify
items.fact: Salsify is a long white root vegetable nicknamed the oyster plant for its mild taste

items.name: Yacon
items.fact: Yacon is a South American root that tastes surprisingly sweet like apple and pear

items.name: Oca
items.fact: Oca is a colorful tuber from the Andes eaten as a potato substitute in South America
